title: Learning Fields
tagline: Help Farmer Fenn's farm learn from samples: how a computer finds patterns in examples, makes predictions, and checks honestly that they work.

funFacts.text: The term machine learning was coined in 1959 by Arthur Samuel, who worked at IBM on computer game-playing.
The k-nearest neighbours method was first developed by Evelyn Fix and Joseph Hodges in 1951.
A support vector machine only needs the points on the edge of its margin to make predictions. The other points could move and nothing would change.
A checker that never flags anything can still score 95 percent accuracy, if only 1 item in 20 is a problem. It also catches none of them.

starRules: 3 stars: no mistakes and no hints. 2 stars: up to 2 mistakes. 1 star: you finished.
